phase: US financial V5 — private PostgreSQL TEST commercial continuity

invariants.book: Same immutable ERP4 baseline, policy, promotion, ordered events and derived cursor/hash. SQL independently reconstructs all admitted event bodies, snapshots, postings and receipts. No second writable current state.
invariants.commercial: Closed three-command set. Commercial operations advance book revision but add no ledger audit/posting. Private transient ERP4 header excludes credits and counts payments only; actual ledger includes all. Live customer edits preserve historical document snapshots; repeated entity IDs and no-op delta are legitimate.
invariants.receipts: Outer V5 ERP request hash differs from captured inner ERP receipt. Exact historical retries require origin prefix/actor/hash and preserve living authority; all legacy/promotion/financial/commercial keys share the reserved index.
invariants.sources: PO008 checks current frozen sales-order source only on new append/direct insert under workspace lock, never pure replay/read/receipt/exact retry. Baseline project must be present, active and belong to the customer. No new/cancelled orders or projects are enabled by this port.
invariants.money: Canonical decimal minor-unit strings, SQL NUMERIC/TypeScript BigInt; settlement cumulative half-up allocation remains. Received/credited/outstanding remain distinct. No tax provider/refund action.
invariants.authority: Living versioned PostgreSQL TEST grant, current configuration/policy under locks; owner/admin/accountant only, member/read_only not opened. Capture and monotone trusted pre/post clock checks retained; final revocation wins. Not an atomic distributed D1/Auth/Stripe revocation protocol.
invariants.commit: Exact prefix SHA and revision CAS; event/receipt/cursor deferred atomicity. Old foundation stays closed to tails; old settlement read/receipt/append reject any ERP tail before replay. Named factory profiles only, no generic public profile selector or fallback.
invariants.migration: New additive migration locks and validates prior settlement books/plans/cursors/receipts before replacements; no rewrite. RLS/PUBLIC/anon/authenticated revokes and invoker/search_path empty retained. service_role is trusted; grant/plan provision remains DB-owner-only. Legacy sidecars and global TRUNCATE restrictions inherited.

adapter.transport: Synthetic RPC responses; actual kernel/ERP engine. Not hosted SQL.

postgres.execution: Real local PostgreSQL WASM: 27 prior migrations, actual synthetic ERP4 tax TEST invoice and settlement tail, then additive commercial migration; new RPCs and guards
postgres.storage: Same NodeFS dataDir clean close/reopen, exact book/receipts/freeze retained
